landing.heroDesc: Awọn iyika ifowopamọ aifọwọyi lori Stellar. Odo intermediaries. Ijọba ọba-owo fun 1.3 bilionu ti ko ni banki.
landing.feat1Desc: Awọn adehun Smart fi agbara mu gbogbo ofin. Ko si oluṣeto le ṣiṣe si pa pẹlu awọn pool. Gbogbo ilowosi jẹri lori-pq.
landing.feat2Desc: Ẹnikẹni pẹlu Stellar apamọwọ. Ko si iroyin banki. Ko si kirẹditi ayẹwo. Ko si awọn aala.
landing.feat3Desc: Kọ MoiScore rẹ pẹlu gbogbo ilowosi akoko. Idanimọ owo to ṣee gbe.
landing.feat4Desc: Awọn iṣowo ipin-ọgọrun Stellar jẹ ki awọn iyika ojoojumọ wulo. Ko si awọn idiyele pẹpẹ lati ṣẹda tabi darapọ mọ.
landing.feat5Desc: Laileto, ti o wa titi, titaja, tabi Idibo. Circle rẹ, awọn ofin rẹ.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC loni. Diẹ stablecoins lori ọna-ọna.
landing.readyDesc: Ṣẹda Circle ifowopamọ akọkọ rẹ labẹ iṣẹju meji.
